----- Virtual Environment -----

1. install venv
python -m venv myvenv(.venv)

2. Activate venv
source myvenv/bin/activate -> for linux
myvenv\Scripts\activate.bat -> for windows

3. Deactivate venv
deactivate



----- How to run fastAPI backend -----

uvicorn main:app --reload


--> after run server in fastapi when go to in url and write /docs open auto generated document
